title: Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767)", at revision 1370607028, opens: "The Burmese–Siamese War of 1765–1767, also known as the War of the Second Fall of Ayutthaya was the second military conflict between Burma under the Konbaung dynasty and Ayutthaya Kingdom under the Siamese Ban Phlu Luang dynasty that lasted from 1765 until 1767; the war ended the 417-year-old Ayutthaya Kingdom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q31307, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict between the Burmese Empire and the Thai kingdom of Ayutthaya". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
